output.hook: You missed a day. So you deleted the app.

scenes.visual: Close-up of a phone screen showing a broken streak notification from a generic habit app, finger hovering over 'Delete App'
scenes.voiceover: You missed a day. So you deleted the app.

scenes.visual: Cut to Streakly home screen — warm cream background (#FFF8F0), habit list with orange streak flames, all intact and glowing
scenes.voiceover: What if missing a day didn't have to mean starting over?

scenes.visual: Screen recording: user taps a missed habit, a gentle 'Repair Streak' prompt appears in teal (#2EC4B6), user taps it, streak flame stays lit with a small '+' badge
scenes.voiceover: Streakly lets you repair a missed day by doubling up later in the week. Your streak survives real life.

scenes.visual: Weekly summary screen showing a colourful progress ring — 5 of 7 days hit, marked as 'Weekly Win' in warm orange (#FF7A59). No leaderboard, no social feed visible.
scenes.voiceover: It scores you on weekly targets, not unbroken daily chains. No guilt. No leaderboards. Just your habits, on your phone.

scenes.visual: Split screen: left shows a 4.8-star TestFlight review card; right shows the day-30 retention stat displayed as a simple graphic — '41% still going at day 30'
scenes.voiceover: 4.8 stars from our beta. And 41% of testers are still tracking at day 30 — way past the usual quit point.

scenes.visual: App icon animates onto screen, tagline fades in: 'Habits that survive real life.' URL appears below.
scenes.voiceover: Streakly. Free during beta. Give it one more try — this time it's built for you. {APP_URL}

production_notes: Record a clean screen capture of the Streakly home screen with at least 3 active habits showing streak flames — use the warm cream (#FFF8F0) theme.
Record the streak repair flow end-to-end: tap missed habit → 'Repair Streak' prompt → confirmation that streak is intact. Keep it under 6 seconds of footage.
Capture the weekly summary / progress ring screen showing a 'Weekly Win' state — ideally 5 or 6 of 7 days completed.
Prepare a simple static graphic showing '41% still tracking at day 30' and '4.8 ★ from 96 TestFlight reviews' — use brand colours, Nunito font.
Record the app icon animation or use a still of the icon on a clean background for the closing card.
Do NOT use stock footage of people exercising or journaling — keep all visuals as real app screens to avoid misleading viewers.
Background music: light, warm, lo-fi instrumental — nothing high-energy or motivational-gym-vibe.
warnings: Retention stat (41% at day 30) is self-reported from a single TestFlight cohort — do not present it as independently verified in any paid ad context.
App Store listing is noted as 'in review' — confirm public availability before publishing this video.
No Android version exists; if distributing on Android-heavy platforms, add a disclaimer or hold the video until Android support ships.
